youtube.title: Why Casino Dice Have Holes Drilled In 🎲 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Casino dice are precision-made cubes with the pips drilled into each face. Drilling removes material, so the face with six pips would end up lighter than the face with one. Manufacturers fill every pip with paint of the same density as the plastic, which keeps the die balanced and fair.
